You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figure 1, which of the following conditions is most consistent with the observed radiological features such as marked interstitial changes and low lung volumes, considering the clinical context of a 40-year-old male with progressive dyspnea and history of recurrent atypical pneumonia?

A) Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis  
B) Follicular Bronchiolitis  
C) Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)  
D) Pulmonary Edema  
E) Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis  
F) Organizing Pneumonia
